title: Final Grade Calculator: What Score Do I Need on the Final?
description: Find the score you need on your final exam to reach your target grade, or work out your weighted course grade from homework, quizzes and exams, with formulas.
lead: What do I need on my final to get a B? Enter your current grade, how much the final counts and the grade you want, and see the exact score you need. You can also work out a weighted course grade.
keywords: what do I need on my final
what grade do I need on the final to pass
